decisions.input_condition: An installation supplied 86% of its scheme-year heat to one or more hospitals and otherwise meets the period application/list requirements
decisions.expected_decision: Hospital-service eligibility condition passes; retain separate proof of list inclusion and effective allocation period
decisions.risk_prevented: Treating hospital association without the heat-share test as sufficient

decisions.input_condition: An installation supplied 84% of its scheme-year heat to hospitals
decisions.expected_decision: Hospital-service route fails the 85% threshold; assess the small-emitter route independently rather than rounding up
decisions.risk_prevented: False HSE qualification through percentage rounding

decisions.input_condition: A combustion installation has reportable emissions below 25,000 tCO2e and rated thermal input below 35 MW for every required evidence year
decisions.expected_decision: Threshold conditions pass, subject to application timing, evidence and inclusion in the applicable HSE list
decisions.risk_prevented: Ignoring period and list gates after numeric screening

decisions.input_condition: Reportable emissions are 24,900 tCO2e but rated thermal input is 35.2 MW
decisions.expected_decision: Small-emitter route fails because both applicable thresholds must be satisfied

decisions.input_condition: An installation operating on or before 1 January 2021 reports 25,100 tCO2e in one of 2021, 2022 or 2023
decisions.expected_decision: Do not classify the historical small-emitter condition as passed for 2026-2030
decisions.risk_prevented: Averaging multiple years and hiding a single-year breach

decisions.input_condition: Regulated activity began between 2 January 2022 and 1 January 2023 and emissions were 2,499 tCO2e or below in 2023 and 2024
decisions.expected_decision: Historical USE emissions condition passes for that start-date band, subject to valid application and list inclusion

decisions.input_condition: Regulated activity began between 2 January 2023 and 1 January 2024 and 2024 emissions were 2,499 tCO2e or below
decisions.expected_decision: Historical USE emissions condition passes for that start-date band, subject to valid application and list inclusion
decisions.risk_prevented: Requiring unavailable pre-operation years or omitting the 2024 test

decisions.input_condition: A 2026-2030 USE emits 2,501 tCO2e in scheme year 2026
decisions.expected_decision: Flag loss-of-USE qualification, preserve monitored emissions and trigger the regulator-notification and permit-transition workflow
decisions.risk_prevented: Keeping an emitter in simplified status after a threshold breach

decisions.input_condition: A 2026-2030 HSE reports annual emissions above 25,000 tCO2e in 2026
decisions.expected_decision: Flag HSE exit and transition to the main UK ETS in the following scheme year after regulator notification
decisions.risk_prevented: Continuing HSE treatment after a statutory exit condition

decisions.input_condition: An installation is a valid HSE for the applicable period
decisions.expected_decision: Apply annual emissions targets; do not create a surrender obligation or free-allocation entitlement for that HSE status
decisions.risk_prevented: Mixing main-scheme allowance accounting with HSE target compliance

decisions.input_condition: An installation received free allocation in 2021-2025 but is on a 2026-2030 HSE or USE list
decisions.expected_decision: Set 2026 free allocation entitlement to none unless an independently verified transition rule applies
decisions.risk_prevented: Carrying prior-period free allocation into simplified status

decisions.input_condition: An installation is a type 1 incumbent for the 2026 allocation period
decisions.expected_decision: Use its 2025 free allocation after relevant 2025 activity-level-change adjustment as the 2026 basis
decisions.risk_prevented: Using 2023 activity data for the wrong incumbent type

decisions.input_condition: An installation is a type 2 incumbent for the 2026 allocation period
decisions.expected_decision: Use verified 2023 activity levels as the 2026 allocation basis and preserve type-2 classification evidence
decisions.risk_prevented: Copying the 2025 entitlement into a type-2 case

decisions.input_condition: An operator seeks free allocation for 2027-2030
decisions.expected_decision: Require completed stage 1 in April-June 2025 and stage 2 in April-June 2026; reject stage 2 as sufficient on its own
decisions.risk_prevented: Awarding allocation from an incomplete application sequence

decisions.input_condition: A final eligible installation allocation is approved and no regulator withholding instruction exists
decisions.expected_decision: Expect registry allocation by 28 February of the calendar year; keep late or withheld cases separately flagged
decisions.risk_prevented: Treating a planned entitlement as already credited to the operator account
